svg.title: MLOps AutoShield Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: A layered architecture diagram showing the self-healing MLOps pipeline with Llama 3.3 70B agents, CI/CD gating, drift analysis, and automated observability across five phases.

svg.text: Phase 3 — GenAI CI/CD agents (Llama 3.3 70B via Groq)
